content: service method RequestTransition [SWS_SM_91107] Upstream: RS_SM_00001 , RS_SM_00004 RequestTransition (IN TransitionRequestType TransitionRequest) Has to be called by a SMControlApplication to request a change in the referenced StateMachine. Scope service interface StateMachineService class mono Fire & Forget false class mono Version 1.0 class mono Parameter th Name th Richtung th Typ th Beschreibung td TransitionRequest td IN td TransitionRequestType td Represents the value to be used as TransitionRequest value in the Transition RequestTable. Application Errors th Fehler th Beschreibung td kInvalidValue td The provided value is not mapped to any transition. td kTransitionNotAllowed td Requested transition is not possible from current StateMachine state. td kRecoveryTransitionOngoing td Request will not be carried out, because currently recovery is ongoing. td kTransitionFailed td During transition to the requested state an error occurred. td kOperationCanceled td The request was replaced by a newer one and therefore it was cancelled td kUpdateInProgress td Requested operation is not allowed as update session is in progress.
